evals.title: Collective credit and calibrated causality
evidence: Independently reproduced the expected SHA-256 fingerprint across the runner's 42 candidate files.
The selected social claim explicitly treats @KCTownHall as an institutional account, disclaims post-by-post attribution to Jamie, and credits KC Town Hall LLC collaborators on the public work record.
The graph distinguishes Jamie's City-recorded developer/presenter role, collective project activity, governmental funding decisions, and Jamie's separately attributed first-hand transition account.

Council Member responses are limited to three date-supported direct responses and explicitly do not establish endorsement, policy adoption, or causality; KCMO311 is labeled a service response, and tags or mentions alone are excluded.
The Bridging the Gap record is framed as collaborator corroboration of one tire drop-off, with exact counts, total scale, savings, and causal health outcomes expressly excluded.

The funding claim distinguishes recommendation, acceptance, appropriation, agreement execution, receipt, expenditure, withdrawal, and reappropriation; the social archive is expressly barred from proving that chain or project completion.
The immutable fixture at commit 303fcd47f6760d15822d793f1a744cfe17055ad8 is byte-identical to the reviewed fixture, and the protected transition source is absent from the public registry.
Focused and adjacent test suites passed 39 of 39 tests, including population integrity, shared-account authorship, funding boundaries, public-safety exclusions, and citation ordering.
findings: No substantive collective-credit theft, authorship inflation, misleading causal inference, or protected-source exposure was found.
evals.recommended_next_move: Preserve the institutional-authorship and causality boundaries; keep tire totals and survey uptake held until the two open research tasks produce independent evidence.

evals.title: Source-backed strength through Chad's lens
evidence: The case study leads with the specific official-record action that Jamie was KC Town Hall's developer/presenter, then explains the purpose and usable outputs: planning, public-benefit documentation, stakeholder context, and municipal-review support.

The selected social projection compresses the 183-record archive into one hiring-relevant operating argument: resident input, recurring service intake, civic-resource circulation, and bounded stakeholder dialogue, rather than presenting the site as an archive browser.

Row-level reproduction confirmed 183 unique primary records; 170 Posts records; 183 Replies-primary records plus five excluded context cards; 142 originals, 13 replies, 28 reposts; and 155 account-authored records.

Row-level reproduction also confirmed 118 link-bearing records, 133 link occurrences, 31 distinct short URLs, 100 tire-related records, and 12 survey-linked records with documented classification methods.

The volatile interaction snapshot reproduces from account-authored rows as 77 records with interaction, 22 replies, 70 reposts, 174 likes, one bookmark, and 267 units, while the claim explicitly subordinates these figures to context.

The public narrative candidly retains the unused-funds ending and presents the mission-aligned transition as Jamie's first-hand account, without importing private circumstances or conflating it with the City's withdrawal record.
The two open tasks retain the highest-value unresolved questions: independent tire-outcome corroboration and recovery of survey/site materials linking invitations to synthesis or decisions.

Citation numbering follows first visible claim appearance: developer/presenter source first, nine institutional-social sources second, three funding-chain sources third; transition evidence remains non-public and uncited.
findings: No substantive professional-legibility defect was found; the page supplies a clear action-purpose-result argument while keeping deeper archival detail in the bank.
evals.recommended_next_move: Keep the current projection disciplined; strengthen it only if independent evidence connects tire outcomes or resident input to verified quantities, decisions, or implementation results.
